title: Clear and White, Crisp French Tips

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to close the gap between me and Tosen Jordan,
I was browsing around to check out recent trends, when...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Wait, what're you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, checking out trends, huh...
Isn't that stuff just kinda, like, a vibe?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like from your besties or social media~. Whatever blows up gets big,
and while that's hot, the next new thing drops~. Ya know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, don't take notes, that's so cringe.
...Can't believe you're doing this on your precious day off.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Pretty much, I guess?
Anyway, if you wanna learn trends, there's way easier ways, duh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Your trainee is right in front of you, hello~?
Guess I got no choice. Lemme show you how we hang out~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with Tosen Jordan suddenly in high spirits,
she began teaching me her idea of 'hanging out'—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
First up, purikura while our hair and makeup are still slaying.
It's a whole different vibe from phone filters, so we gotta snap some.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You can totally ignore the pose prompts.
What should I do today? Eh, it's just Trainer, so the usual's fine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like this~! Easy, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you even trying?
You gotta do it like, 'I am the absolute cutest♪' ya know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. If your mindset isn't slaying, your face won't slay either.
Carve that into your brain and try again! C'mon, chop-chop~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm... Oh, that top is so cute~!
The cropped look is totally fire~. Love it.
choice_data_list: Why not go try it on?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay, I'd haaate that~~. If I try it on, I'll wanna buy it, duh.
That brand is hella pricey. Totally out of my allowance budget~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So instead, right? You burn it into your brain~,
and hunt down a lookalike at a fast-fashion place.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, 'I've memorized your face, got it~?'
Just kidding~, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Bro, at least laugh. Let's go~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Omg, that top is so cute~!
I've been wanting an oversized one~. It's cheap too, totally buying it♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm~... Tough call~. Trainer, are you cool-toned or warm-toned?
No clue at all. Well, as long as it looks cute, who cares, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Orange-ish eyeshadow~, layer some holographic glitter on top~.
Fill in with white eyeliner. Curl those lashes to high heaven and pink mascara~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~? Shouldn't you be saying 'make me gorgeous' instead?
Not like I got crazy skills anyway. ...Imma give you a unibrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I got a full rundown on
Tosen Jordan's typical day of hanging out—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for the treat~! Ahh, frappes are the absolute best~.
Their new flavors never miss.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, how was today? This is literally how I always hang.
Just messing around, chilling while staring at our phones~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...But honestly, for you~,
it was pretty boring, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, your face was totally stiff the whole time~.
You looked completely lost, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were definitely moments where I struggled to keep up with the unfamiliar vibe.
Knowing there was no point in faking it, I gave my honest thoughts...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right~? I kinda kept worrying about you too,
so I couldn't get super hyped either.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I said 'super,' okay?
It's not like I said it was boring or anything.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm just saying, it's crystal clear now~.
We're completely different. Like, alien-level different~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's impossible. We can't vibe on the same wavelength.
So you don't gotta force yourself to study what I like anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I might not be book-smart, but I'm not stupid.
I get the thought behind it. Don't push yourself, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just 'cause you're my Trainer doesn't mean you gotta match my wavelength.
You can still coach my training without knowing any of that stuff.
choice_data_list: No, I'm going to keep trying.
No way, I'm going to keep trying.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, why?
choice_data_list: Because I want to understand you, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was true that I wasn't used to her vibe. But that was just because
I hadn't fully settled into it yet; the activities themselves were fresh and fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I got to learn about the things Tosen Jordan loves.
I told her that getting to know her mattered to me, and that it made me truly happy.
choice_data_list: I really had fun today, honestly!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Even though your face was stiff?
choice_data_list: On the inside, I was having a blast.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...You're seriously weird, for real.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, studying is boring, right?
You just want easy, fun stuff to pop up on your feed.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Like, this was such a total buzzkill!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she tossed a bag roughly toward me—inside was the rental DVD
for "Bakushou Derby," a comedy show I had recommended to her before.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Didn't like it at all, though. Felt like a total waste of time.
Still... couldn't just leave my Trainer completely flopping on their own, ya know~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Also, renting a DVD? Haven't done that in ages. Seriously, don't make me work so hard.
Next time... pick something on streaming, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~? Why're you smiling bigger than you did all day? Creep!
Return that for me, will ya? Laters!! Thanks for the frappe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I felt like the distance between me and Tosen Jordan
had closed just a tiny bit.
